title: Autodesk tackles AI filmmaking's biggest problem with 3D control
excerpt: Autodesk's Flow Studio adds a 3D Editor + node-based Canvas so creators can block scenes, direct cameras, characters and timing in a real 3D workspace before AI generates the final look. It reframes AI video from prompt-roulette to directable craft.
rationale: Biggest tool release in the pool: turns generative video from prompt roulette into an art-directable 3D workflow a designer can control tomorrow.

title: Backflip AI's reworked model turns a mesh into editable feature-tree CAD
excerpt: Backflip AI's reworked foundation model converts a mesh into a fully editable feature-tree CAD part in seconds, with a Fusion-facing copilot. For industrial designers it collapses the slowest step between physical scan and editable geometry.
rationale: Generative reverse engineering finally shipping as editable parametric CAD — the most concrete workflow change for industrial designers this week (Engineering.com's CEO interview on the same relaunch dropped as a within-pool duplicate).

title: Vercel gives eve agents a real browser
excerpt: Vercel's eve agents can now drive a real browser via the agent-browser extension — navigating pages, reading content, clicking and filling forms. That gives build-and-verify agents a way to actually look at the UI they just shipped.
rationale: A dated platform release, not commentary: build agents can now inspect and verify the UI they generate, closing the loop designers keep complaining about.

title: What your AI co-designer can't infer from your hex values
excerpt: A designer's set of context files created at the start of every client project to onboard Claude — encoding the intent behind tokens that raw hex values and spacing scales can never convey. Practical design-system plumbing for AI collaborators.
rationale: Copyable practice: a concrete context-file set that encodes token intent for an AI collaborator, advancing rather than repeating the already-published DESIGN.md card.

title: Figma shows how keyframes work in Figma Motion
excerpt: Figma's official walkthrough of keyframes in Figma Motion — setting property values at points in time to build animation directly in the design file, the manual counterpart to the agent-generated motion shown at Config.
rationale: First-party, hands-on coverage of Figma Motion's keyframe model — the craft layer under the AI motion demos, and the only fresh Figma-tool item not already published.
